en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned town square with a central circular flowerbed surrounded by a low metal fence and a tall pedestal bearing a bust statue. Traditional two‑story buildings with awnings line the square, and mature trees form a backdrop; a tower with a cupola rises behind them. Several people, including a child in the foreground, stand near the monument. In the lower left corner, there is a dark label with white handwritten-style text.
